title: Schema for the maps data file: every mission's map (campaign, skirmish, four-player, raid)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

name.description: Map name (a campaign map is named after its mission)

image.description: The file path for this map's image

hidden_sections.description: The sections of the map revealed during its mission, in order, each with its name and image (empty for a map shown whole)

image.description: The file path for the section's image

whole_image.description: For a map with hidden sections: an image of the whole map, its image and then each hidden section in order, in one frame (later sections drawn on top). null for a map without hidden sections.
